title.zh: 【Riot Platforms 与 Anthropic 租赁协议利息为 12%，Riot 出售部分比特币筹集资金】
title.en: 【Riot Platforms 与 Anthropic 租赁协议利息为 12%，Riot 出售部分比特币筹集资金】

current_state.zh: Riot Platforms与Anthropic签署15年约280亿美元AI数据中心协议，提供910 MW容量，年均租金约18亿美元；建设成本约55亿美元，Anthropic可通过租金抵扣回收并获12%年利息；Riot计划债务融资覆盖80-90%成本，自身出资5-11亿美元，融资2027年启动；2026年前九月Riot已售20,264 BTC（约15亿美元），持有2,418 BTC，首批容量预计2027年6月交付。
current_state.en: Riot Platforms signed a 15-year, ~$28B AI data-center agreement with Anthropic to provide 910 MW of capacity, with average annual rent of ~$1.8B; build costs are ~$5.5B, and Anthropic can recover eligible construction costs via rent credits plus 12% annual interest; Riot plans to finance 80–90% via debt, contributing $500M–$1.1B itself, with financing starting in 2027; Riot sold 20,264 BTC (~$1.5B) in the first nine months of 2026, holds 2,418 BTC, and first capacity is expected in June 2027.

updates.title_zh: 矿企Riot与Anthropic签署280亿美元AI数据中心协议，或向其支付12%年利息
updates.title_en: 矿企Riot与Anthropic签署280亿美元AI数据中心协议，或向其支付12%年利息
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增了协议总价值约280亿美元、为期15年、年均租金约18亿美元、债务融资占比80-90%、Riot自身出资5-11亿美元、首批容量预计2027年6月交付等细节。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details on the ~$28B total deal value, 15-year term, ~$1.8B average annual rent, debt financing covering 80–90% of costs, Riot's own $500M–$1.1B equity contribution, and first capacity delivery expected in June 2027.
updates.current_state_zh: Riot Platforms与Anthropic签署15年约280亿美元AI数据中心协议，提供910 MW容量，年均租金约18亿美元；建设成本约55亿美元，Anthropic可通过租金抵扣回收并获12%年利息；Riot计划债务融资覆盖80-90%成本，自身出资5-11亿美元，融资2027年启动；2026年前九月Riot已售20,264 BTC（约15亿美元），持有2,418 BTC，首批容量预计2027年6月交付。
updates.current_state_en: Riot Platforms signed a 15-year, ~$28B AI data-center agreement with Anthropic to provide 910 MW of capacity, with average annual rent of ~$1.8B; build costs are ~$5.5B, and Anthropic can recover eligible construction costs via rent credits plus 12% annual interest; Riot plans to finance 80–90% via debt, contributing $500M–$1.1B itself, with financing starting in 2027; Riot sold 20,264 BTC (~$1.5B) in the first nine months of 2026, holds 2,418 BTC, and first capacity is expected in June 2027.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Riot Platforms signed a 15-year, roughly $28B deal to supply Anthropic with 910 MW of data-center capacity at its Corsicana, Texas site (~$1.8B average annual rent), funded largely by debt against ~$5.5B in build costs, with Anthropic able to recover eligible construction costs via rent credits plus 12% annual interest — while Riot has already liquidated 20,264 BTC in 2026 and holds just 2,418 BTC.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Riot Platforms signed a 15-year, roughly $28B deal to supply Anthropic with 910 MW of data-center capacity at its Corsicana, Texas site (~$1.8B average annual rent), funded largely by debt against ~$5.5B in build costs, with Anthropic able to recover eligible construction costs via rent credits plus 12% annual interest — while Riot has already liquidated 20,264 BTC in 2026 and holds just 2,418 BTC.
